A FRESH PERSPECTIVE

Inspired by heat.
Powered by light.

HEATWAVE remaps the brightness in your camera or photo into a vivid color palette. Move closer, change the light, and see what happens.

It works with an ordinary phone camera or webcam. No temperature readings, body-energy detection, or through-wall imaging. Your frames stay in your browser.

JUST ADD CURIOSITY.
